newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed futures climb, palm oil may ease.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed futures climb, palm oil may ease.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery climbed up to 1,141/1,142 rupees per quintal on Thursday from 1,136 rupees on the back of fresh speculative buying, traders said.
Renewed overseas enquiries for castoroil prompted fresh bull buying for the September delivery.

Daily average arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region were higher at 8,000/10,000 bags (75 kg each) but traders were predicting fall in the arrivals in the coming days. "Average arrivals may go down to 4,000/5,000 bags," one operator said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 362/363 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals and poor local demand, dealers said. In Rajkot, spot groundnut oil rose by 5 rupees to 570 rupees per 15 kg.

In Bombay, imported palm-oil held steady at 258/259 rupees per 10 kg with very little fresh arrivals at the Bombay port, but undercurrent was weak following reports of a setback in the world market, traders said.
"Local prices of palm oil may go down in the coming days," one importer said.
